content.value_statement: Slow Angular apps lose users and waste development time. This skill gives prioritized patterns for faster rendering, smaller bundles, and safer refactors.
actual_capabilities: Reviews Angular components for change detection, Signals, and OnPush usage.
Suggests patterns to remove async waterfalls and improve SSR data loading.
Identifies bundle reduction opportunities with lazy routes, dynamic imports, and deferred content.
Recommends rendering improvements for lists, templates, pipes, and virtual scrolling.
Checks state and subscription patterns for avoidable re-renders and memory leaks.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not automated performance measurements.
It does not replace profiling with Angular DevTools, Lighthouse, or production telemetry.
It may need project context before recommending SSR, hydration, or state architecture changes.
It does not guarantee compatibility with every Angular version or library combination.

use_cases.title: Review a Feature Module
use_cases.description: Find performance issues before merging a new Angular page or component set.

use_cases.title: Plan a Refactor
use_cases.description: Prioritize changes for a slow Angular application without rewriting unrelated code.

use_cases.title: Improve Code Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Generate focused review comments for Angular rendering, bundles, and data loading.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Angular component for basic performance issues. Focus on OnPush, Signals, template work, and subscription cleanup. Give prioritized fixes.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize a Route
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Angular route and feature module. Suggest lazy loading, deferred content, and bundle reductions. Keep changes scoped and explain tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit SSR Data Flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Angular SSR flow. Look for client-side waterfalls, hydration issues, TransferState gaps, and blocking data needs. Return a prioritized plan.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Performance Refactor
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a phased refactor plan for this Angular app. Cover change detection, state selectors, rendering, memory cleanup, and validation steps.

output_examples.input: A component uses default change detection, mutable fields, and a method call inside the template.
output_examples.output: The response flags change detection first, recommends reactive state, and moves repeated calculations out of the template.

output_examples.input: A dashboard loads charts, profile data, and related lists during initial navigation.
output_examples.output: The response recommends lazy route loading, deferred chart rendering, parallel data loading, and SSR preloading for critical profile data.

output_examples.input: A review asks whether an Angular list page can handle thousands of rows.
output_examples.output: The response suggests virtual scrolling, stable item tracking, pure transformations, and measurement with production-like data.

best_practices: Start with the highest impact bottleneck before applying small template optimizations.
Use project profiling data when choosing SSR, hydration, lazy loading, and rendering changes.
Keep refactors scoped so behavior, accessibility, and tests remain easy to verify.
anti_patterns: Applying every rule without checking the Angular version and project constraints.
Replacing simple code with complex abstractions before measuring performance impact.
Ignoring server rendering, hydration, and data loading when only tuning components.

faq.question: Does this skill execute code?
faq.answer: No. It is a documentation skill that guides reviews and refactors.

faq.question: Can it replace Angular DevTools or Lighthouse?
faq.answer: No. Use those tools to measure results before and after changes.

faq.question: Which Angular topics does it cover?
faq.answer: It covers change detection, Signals, lazy loading, rendering, SSR, templates, state, and memory management.

faq.question: Can Claude Code or Codex use it during reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. Ask the assistant to apply the checklist to the files you provide.

faq.question: Is it only for new Angular projects?
faq.answer: No. It also supports refactors and performance reviews for existing Angular applications.

faq.question: Does it provide version-specific migration advice?
faq.answer: It gives general guidance. Confirm API support against your Angular version before changing production code.
